title: Jany-Latyn: A Latin Orthography and Comparative Testbed for the Kyrgyz Language
description: A Latin orthography for Kyrgyz designed to be derivable from Cyrillic, with a deterministic conversion engine and a testbed in which each contested orthographic choice is a selectable option.
notes: This repository is licensed in three parts: the conversion engine (packages/engine/) under MIT, the testbed web application (apps/web/) under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, and the whitepaper and specification (docs/) under CC BY 4.0. See LICENSING.md. The record lists CC BY 4.0 because the archive is chiefly cited for the whitepaper and specification.
